retention_tricks: Fast Pacing: Rapid cuts, quick transitions, minimal dead air.
Text On Screen: Dynamic text highlighting key points or adding humor.
Sound Design: Engaging sound effects, trending audio, unexpected sounds.
Visual Storytelling: Showing rather than just telling, using B-roll, animations.
Open Loop: Hinting at future revelations or a surprise ending.
Mystery/Reveal: Presenting a problem or question then gradually revealing the answer.
